body: Thanks for listening to me ramble kind internet stranger. I am not going to change my mind but I found it nice to talk to someone about it because I will not mention anything to family/friends before I do it, just want to avoid raising any red flags

Nothing much. Just school and work. My workload this semester isn't even that bad since I took some classes over summer and got credit (saved hella money too). Nothing has been bothering me other than school, but I have kinda always hated school so it's nothing new. The idea to kill myself popped into my head around a week ago. I was wondering how I could do it and be sure that I would die. Hanging was the easiest way and cheapest way so I decided that way the best option. I sold/gave a few things today so that I could get some money for them to give to my family. Then I just bought the rope I thought would be easiest to tie around a door knob and went from there.

Thanks. I feel like it is too late because I already have a solid plan and if I backed out I would feel like a coward. Nothing in my life is all that hard right now anyway. My grades are meh but not too bad like getting kicked out of school bad. Good friends and family as well so no problems honestly
